content: Chatwoot widget CSP requires: script-src/frame-src/style-src/font-src pointed at the Chatwoot subdomain, connect-src including explicit wss://<chatwoot-domain> for the realtime WebSocket, and img-src for avatars/attachments. Plain https:// in connect-src is not sufficient for the WebSocket; must add wss:// explicitly. Dashboard App / widget also has known postMessage origin-validation issues (CVE-2025-12245 in IFrameHelper.js up to Chatwoot 4.7.0) — verify origin explicitly rather than trusting iframe URL secrecy.
